dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for both station names, call signs, domains, canonical contact paths and the WVUM Music Director mailbox before insertion. No prior WJCU or WVUM record was found. WJCU's Triple-A email route, all-other-genres physical route, staff contacts and station address were assessed together and consolidated into one opportunity, with only the genre-appropriate physical Music Director route queued. WVUM's staff directory, Music Director mailbox and music-programming page were consolidated into one restricted asset-free inquiry record because the station does not publish complete delivery specifications.
emailVerificationLevel: WVUM publishes md@wvum.org in plaintext on its official Contact page for its named Music Directors. Verification covered valid syntax, exact Music Director purpose, first-party wvum.org domain alignment and current official-site activity. WJCU publishes relevant Music Director role addresses in intentionally obfuscated or non-plaintext form; they were not decoded, guessed or stored, and the primary queued WJCU route is the explicitly authorized physical Music Director address. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, inquiry, phone call, physical package, stream, download link, audio file, attachment, EPK, biography, metadata, personal information, rights declaration or payment was sent. No obfuscated WJCU contact was decoded or guessed, no undocumented digital delivery route was inferred, and no CAPTCHA, anti-bot, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
